name: Freight Broker Operations
audience: small freight brokerages and shipper-carrier coordination teams
topic: carrier qualification and accessorial evidence for freight brokers

products.name: Carrier Packet Completeness
products.product: A focused freight carrier packet completeness tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small freight brokerages and shipper-carrier coordination teams
products.problem: Carrier onboarding documents, authority checks, insurance evidence, agreements, payment details, and internal approvals arrive through portals and email without one load-ready decision.
products.valueProposition: Turns freight carrier packet completeness tracking into a visible operating queue so every carrier assigned to a load has current required evidence, approved exceptions, and a verified qualification decision.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets freight carrier packet, carrier onboarding checklist, freight broker carrier compliance, and carrier qualification tracker searches.

products.name: Detention Evidence Desk
products.product: A focused freight detention evidence tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small freight brokerages and shipper-carrier coordination teams
products.problem: Arrival and departure times, free-time terms, driver messages, location evidence, facility acknowledgments, customer approval, and carrier payment are difficult to reconcile after a load.
products.valueProposition: Turns freight detention evidence tracking into a visible operating queue so every detention request is evaluated from agreed terms and time evidence, then reconciled across customer charge and carrier payment.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets freight detention tracker, driver detention evidence, accessorial approval workflow, and freight detention claim searches.
